title: Guest Relations Manager
summary: Own the arrival and the whole stay for a house of eighteen residences, and know every guest by name by the second morning.

title: Sous Chef, Thalassa
summary: Run the charcoal and wood oven section on a menu that is rewritten every afternoon around what the boats landed.

title: Spa Therapist
summary: Deliver hammam rituals and deep tissue work in four treatment rooms cut into the hillside.

title: Residence Host
summary: Look after the villas and residences: breakfast in-house, the day put together before it is asked for, nothing announced.

title: Sommelier
type: Full season, with winter buying trips
summary: Build and pour a four hundred label cellar that leans hard into Greek producers, and host two tastings a week.

title: Skipper, Elysis catamaran
summary: Take ten guests out at six, find the cove with nobody in it, and have them back under the stars.
